subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should the built-in `/usage full` footer show the active provider’s prepared quota windows by default, or should those windows remain limited to status/UI surfaces or an advanced custom template?
rationale: The technical snapshot and cache ownership now exist, but choosing the default chat density and replay semantics changes a user-visible product contract and cannot be inferred safely from implementation convenience.

options.title: Show Windows In Full Footer
options.body: Expose prepared provider windows through the generic contract and include a compact summary in `/usage full`, omitting it when the snapshot is unavailable.

options.title: Custom Templates Only
options.body: Expose quota windows to `messages.usageTemplate` while keeping the built-in footer unchanged for users who want a quieter default.

options.title: Keep Status-Only
options.body: Keep provider quotas on `/status`, CLI, Control UI, and app surfaces and close this request as outside the per-response footer contract.

recommendation.title: Show Windows In Full Footer
recommendation.body: Expose prepared provider windows through the generic contract and include a compact summary in `/usage full`, omitting it when the snapshot is unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and recently maintained both the renderer and built-in default-footer product boundary.
